profile.headline: Software Embedded Engineer | Complex Problem Solver
profile.summary:
Highly experienced engineer with strong background in the fields of Automotive, motor controls, automation. Hybrid Batteries, OBD 2, CAN-Bus.

Strong skills in writing software for low level hardware and application code in embedded systems.

Strong electronics skill to debug hardware issues and solving software to hardware interface issues.
Experienced in multiple communication protocols.
o	Ethernet
o	CAN Bus
o	UART, SPI, I2C, etc.

Experienced with electronic test tools including.
o	Oscilloscope 
o	CAN Bus tools 
o	Logic analyzer

CORE COMPETENCIES
•	Experienced with microprocessors, microcontroller, and FPGA.
•	Experienced with multiple electronic venders.
o	TI DSP (Code Composer)
o	NXP(Freescale) (Code Warrior)
o	Renesas (Hitachi Embedded Environment)
o	Altera and Xilinx FPGA’s (Max2 Plus 2, Quartus, Vivado) 
•	Experienced in “C”, Simulink, LabVIEW
•	Experienced in motor control, PMSM (Permanent magnet Synchronous motor), Induction, and stepper motors.
•	Experience in SAFe, Agile, and scrum software process

ACCOMPLISHMENTS
•	Recognized with patents, innovation award, and internal achievements awards.

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Debugging · Systems Engineering · Embedded Software · Electronics

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Modify and create reusable firmware on refrigeration control boards to add new features and fix bugs on production software.
•	Design Test code using test driven development method.  This is a tool that can exercise code without hardware.
•	Bench test new code using actual hardware and a refrigeration simulator.  Evaluations were performed using JTAG with Eclipse and Visual Code studio, meters, and oscilloscope.
•	Work with the design team to create fast turn prototype solutions by creating software in current production products to investigate the possibility of new features.
•	Create custom software to troubleshoot hardware issues.
•	Support the GE Agile process, by participating in meetings, reviews, scoring stores, and follow sprint timing.
positions.insights: Skills: Debugging · Embedded Systems · Systems Engineering · Embedded Software · Electronics

positions.title: Senior Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
Lead redesign activities when electrical components used on our PCB design are classified as end of life.  
•	Modify firmware in Rockwell drives to support changed components on PCB.  
     o	These components include Microprocessors, FPGA’s, Memory (Flash and RAM), communication 
        (Ethernet, CAN, UART, SPI, etc.).  
          	    Basically any component that reports information to a microprocessor, micro-controller, or 
                    FPGA on any PCB used in our product line of AC drives.  
     o	Due to age of product many times there is no documentation so I am required to reverse                
                engineer design, and verify the current update has not change any of the drives function or 
                features.  
•	Trouble shoot hardware issues
•	Validate final design solution
•	Verify component selection in the new design meet requirements and are the best choice to 
        interface to new components.
•	Support tools and components from the following vendors:     
     o	TI DSP (Code Composer)
     o	NXP(Freescale)(Code Warrior)
     o	Renesas (Hitachi Embedded Environment)
     o	Altera and Xilinx FPGA’s (Max2 Plus 2, Quartus, Vivado)
positions.insights: Skills: Debugging · Embedded Systems · Systems Engineering · Embedded Software · Electronics

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Project management, hardware component selection, software architecture and development for off highway OEM electronic modules.  Work directly with customer to understand and document project requirements.  Support all testing to verify product meets customer requirements.  Work directly with manufacturing for product launch.

Using ST ARM Micro-controllers develop all driver to support hardware interaction and various communication protocols including CAN(Following J1939 standards), I2C, and SPI.
   
Using ST ARM Micro-controllers define all PCB micro-controller connections.

Using ST ARM Micro-controllers develop customer application code.

Design and code LCD graphic interfaces and research and select tools to develop a process for quick turn around.
positions.insights: Skills: Automotive · Debugging · Embedded Systems · Systems Engineering · Embedded Software · Electronics

positions.title: Software Requirements Engineer
positions.description:
Write requirements and develop algorithms in support of meeting customer needs, proper operation of the battery pack, and maximum life for Li-ion batteries used in Hybrid and Plug-in vehicles for both commercial and passenger applications. 

Develop algorithms and support continuous improvement for battery pack cell balancing. Cell balancing algorithms are used to allow the battery pack to have maximum range after being charged and minimal affect on the end user during operation.

Write software requirements to interface battery management unit to cell supervisory circuits using CAN communications for data acquisition and fault information.

Write software requirements in support of “Automotive Software Integrity Level (ASIL)” to allow Johnson Controls to sell battery pack to customers that require meeting the safety standards described in ISO 2626262.

Write software requirements to add new features and update current requirement to increase performance and reliability in Li-ion battery packs.

As new battery technology emerges work directly with chemist and systems engineers to write software requirements and develop algorithms in support of different battery cell chemistries.

Support application engineering group and manufacturing team in diagnosing issues and educate the team on normal operation of the battery management software and battery pack operation.

Attend requirement and software reviews.
positions.insights: Skills: Automotive · Debugging · Embedded Systems · Systems Engineering · Embedded Software · Electronics · HEV

positions.title: Lead OBD Software and EMS Algorithm Engineer
positions.description:
Lead OBD software engineer interfacing with the OBD algorithm team. Responsible for the O2 sensor VIOS layer and the oxygen sensor in plant diagnostic disable algorithms.

Led the direction for Onboard diagnostics (OBD) Powertrain software for coding standards and assisted in algorithm design to best integrate into current software configuration.

Designed Powertrain algorithms and supported integration issues specifically for the O2 sensor interface to meet customer requirements or continuous design improvements.

Assisted junior software engineers in proper software implementation and design in the Powertrain diagnostic area.

Setup and configured Math Works PolySpace for the software team. 

Wrote PolySpace configuration file generator to greatly reduce the time and complexity of setting up the tool.

Wrote production code and updated supporting documentation for engine and transmission control modules. Participated in the formal software design review process. Used software quality tools such as PolySpace and QA C every software change. 

Performed software verification on bench and in vehicle using ETAS INCA and Lauterbach Trace32.

Supported algorithm design reviews to point out potential issues that may cause confusion or encourage poor coding and use up hardware resources unnecessarily.
positions.insights: Skills: Automotive · Debugging · Embedded Systems · Systems Engineering · Embedded Software · Electronics

positions.title: Senior Staff Engineer
positions.description:
*Motorola Automotive division was sold to Continental*

Systems engineer for driveline systems group, supporting transmission TECHM and 4x4 transfer case embedded controller.

Performed software and hardware verification on bench and in vehicle for transmission, and 4x4 transfer case control modules using Vector CANape and CANalyzer.

Verified customer-failed transmission TECHM units. Determined if failure was hydraulic or electronic, sent unit to appropriate repair facility.
positions.insights: Skills: Automotive · Debugging · Embedded Systems · Systems Engineering · Embedded Software · Electronics

positions.title: Senior Staff Engineer
positions.description:
Onsite software and systems engineering support for electronic power steering systems.

Algorithm development for embedded controller hardware diagnostics. Calibrated and validated diagnostics to verify system met customer specifications.

Onsite software support for electronic power steering systems.

Wrote production code and updated supporting documentation for an electronic power steering module, a safety critical device in a CMM level 3 organization. Participated in Fagan reviews. 

Developed new requirements working directly with the customer at their location.

Prototyped software to evaluate new customer requirements and potential algorithm modifications.

Designed and wrote special test software to verify proper system operations for testing scenarios where conditions are not easily created.

Acted as a single point of contact for software issues between the customer and Motorola/Continental.
positions.insights: Skills: Automotive · Debugging · Embedded Systems · Systems Engineering · Embedded Software · Electronics
